verdict.rationale: Unreal documents real automation surfaces: Python editor scripting to automate repetitive asset tasks and pipelines, the Unreal Automation Tool for testing and building, and headless commandlets like `-run=cook` that can be invoked from the command line. However, nothing in the evidence shows built-in scheduling, triggers, or agent-driven background automations. Unattended runs therefore depend on external schedulers or CI, and probes found no official MCP or agent integration. Missing for 10: native background scheduling and triggers, agentic or AI-driven automation features, an official agent/MCP integration, independent hands-on corroboration of unattended automation.
